syncFailed: Sync failed — previous data is still live
syncRateLimited: Refresh is limited — wait a moment before trying again
registryEmptyBody: Orbit needs a valid Confluence page layout before it can show Hierarchy or Explorer. Add the required tables on each company page, then click Refresh.
syncStructureBody: Sync could not build a valid registry from your Confluence pages. Fix the tables below, then click Refresh. Previous data stays live until a successful sync.
syncConfigBody: Sync could not reach or authenticate with Confluence using your server env. Fix the settings below (in `.env` for local, or deploy secrets), restart registry-service, then click Refresh. Previous data stays live until a successful sync.
sampleCopied: Sample tables copied — paste into your Confluence page
confluenceConfigRuleEmail: CONFLUENCE_EMAIL — service-account email that owns the API token
confluenceConfigRuleToken: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN — create at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens (never paste the token into the UI)
confluenceConfigRulePageIds: CONFLUENCE_PAGE_IDS — comma-separated numeric ids from each company page URL (.../pages/<id>/...)
confluenceConfigRuleMock: MOCK_CONFLUENCE=false when using live Confluence (true only serves the local seed fixture)
confluenceConfigHowTo: Page id: open the company page → copy the number after /pages/. Token: Atlassian account → Security → Create API token. Grant the account View on the Confluence space only.
confluenceGuideRulePage: One Confluence page per company (set CONFLUENCE_PAGE_IDS).
confluenceGuideRuleConfig: Company config table (Key | Value) with at least a Name row.
confluenceGuideRuleTeams: Teams table whose headers include Team Name and Queue Key (also Tribe and Domain).
confluenceGuideRuleQueue: Queue Key format like HLX-CHK — unique across ALL companies.
confluenceGuideRuleIcon: Icon = supported icon name; Color = hue 0–360 (optional; team color falls back to domain).
confluenceGuideRuleOptional: Optional Domains (Name | Color | Description) and Links (Source Key | Target Key | Reason) tables.
confluenceGuideDocsHint: Full contract, optional columns, and troubleshooting: docs/CONFLUENCE_SETUP.md in the repo.
readOnly: Read-only. Teams are edited on the Confluence tables; changes appear here on the next sync.
chatIntro: Describe your issue or question — I'll point you to the right team and ticket queue.
chatPlaceholderFallback: customer says the invoice is wrong
chatError: Couldn't reach the assistant. Try again.
startersFallback: Where should I route this ticket?
